whoWeAre.name: Who We Are
whoWeAre.title: MAKU is a strategic branding and marketing agency that highlights the best of your brand.
whoWeAre.subtitle: Through our proven ABCDS Method, we craft strategies and creative that help brands.

ourMethod.name: Our Method
ourMethod.title: We’ve worked with over 55 brands across hospitality, retail, architecture, health, fashion, and more.
ourMethod.subtitle: Strategy shouldn’t be defined by industry, but by brand. Working across industries helps us avoid formulas and build strategies that are truly distinctive.

slogan.1: Because when you highlight the best of your brand…

projects.name: Projects
projects.title: Most brands come with a specific need. Our role is to understand what the brand actually needs to grow.
projects.subtitle: That means looking beyond the initial request and building strategies that strengthen the brand, its connection with customers, and its long-term performance.

services.name: Services
services.title: Whether you’re launching something new or ready to evolve, we offer:

items.body: Build real relationships with your audience by offering value.

items.title: Scale faster

items.title: Speak Louder

symbols.title: Symbols carved into stone. Signs painted on walls. Traces that remained long after the moment passed.

subtitle.1: We believe branding and marketing truly matter when they help a brand connect, stand out, and perform better as a business.
subtitle.2: At the core, the question is simple: why should people care about your brand? Our role is to help brands find that answer, and build the strategy to make it clear, relevant, and consistent.

ourBrand.name: About our brand
ourBrand.button: Have a project in mind? Let’s talk

items.title: MAKU means to leave a mark, something that is traced, recognized, and remembered.
items.subtitle: A mark that stays.
items.text: That meaning defines how we think about brands. Not as visuals or slogans, but as what remains after an experience. What people remember. What becomes part of their lives.

items.title: Our yellow exists to highlight that mark, to bring forward what truly matters in every brand, business, and concept.
items.subtitle: Our colors
items.text: Because when something is built with meaning, it doesn’t disappear. It stays. It’s recognized. It leaves a mark.

p.1: Michelle Peniche is a Marketing Specialist & MBA with a strong focus on brand strategy and startup concept creation. Passionate about marketing and creative thinking, she brings a strategic, business-driven approach to every project.
p.2: Having lived in three countries and worked with global brands such as PepsiCo, Colgate, and Steve Madden, Michelle leads MAKU with a clear belief: brands grow when strategy and creativity work together.
